author: Retro Game Corps
description:
ASUS is releasing an updated ROG Xbox Ally X20 with a bigger OLED screen, updated controls, and a transparent color. Here are my first impressions.

More info: https://rog.asus.com/us/gaming-handhelds/rog-ally/rog-xbox-ally-x20-bundle-2026/

Note: ASUS flew me out to COMPUTEX to preview this handheld, but this video is not paid or sponsored.  All opinions are my own, and they did not see this video ahead of time.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
